column1: # bench-models.tsv — model price ASSUMPTIONS for the cost axis of the Pareto bench.
# These are PUBLIC LIST PRICES, per million tokens (USD), and they are an ESTIMATE: real billing
# depends on the plan (a Max subscription bills nothing per token via OAuth — see eval/lib.sh
# billing-safety note), on cache hits, and on the actual token counts a task consumes. The bench
# uses these numbers only to turn measured token counts into a comparable cost-per-task figure.
# The frontier shifts every few weeks (the whole point of the Uber method) — revise this table,
# do not trust it as fixed. Override the whole file with RDA_BENCH_MODELS=/path/to/table.tsv.
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
